docs.text: The render pipeline batches draw calls before the GPU consumes them. Vertex buffers are uploaded once and reused across frames.
Linear color blending avoids the darkening artifacts of gamma-space math. Convert to sRGB only at output.
A TCP connection opens with a three-way handshake: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK. Retransmission timers guard every step.
HTTP caching relies on ETag and Cache-Control headers. A conditional GET returns 304 when nothing changed.
DNS resolution walks from root servers to authoritative ones. Resolvers cache records for their TTL.
A B-tree index keeps keys sorted in wide nodes so lookups touch few pages. Range scans walk the leaves.
Transactions guarantee atomicity and isolation. Write-ahead logging makes committed work durable.
Normalization removes update anomalies by splitting tables. Third normal form is the usual resting point.
The scheduler multiplexes cores across runnable threads. Priorities decay so no thread starves.
Virtual memory maps pages lazily; a page fault pulls data from disk. The TLB caches recent translations.
Journaling file systems replay their log after a crash. Inodes hold metadata; directories map names to them.
The lexer turns characters into tokens with a deterministic finite automaton. Longest match wins.
A recursive-descent parser mirrors the grammar in code. Precedence climbing handles expressions cleanly.
Register allocation colors the interference graph. Spilling moves the coldest values to the stack.
Password storage uses slow salted hashes. A rainbow table is useless against unique salts.
TLS certificates chain to a trusted root. The server proves possession of its private key during the handshake.
Gradient descent follows the negative gradient in small steps. Learning-rate schedules tame the endgame.
Overfitting memorizes the training set. Validation curves reveal it; regularization and more data fight it.
Embeddings place discrete items in a vector space where distance means similarity. Nearest neighbors become search.
CPUs fetch memory in cache lines; strided access wastes most of each line. Structure layout decides bandwidth.
Instruction pipelines overlap fetch, decode and execute. Branch mispredictions flush the work in flight.
An ADC samples above the Nyquist rate or aliases forever. Anti-aliasing filters cut what sampling cannot keep.
Dijkstra grows a frontier of settled vertices by smallest distance. A binary heap keeps extraction cheap.
Dynamic programming trades memory for repeated work. Order the subproblems and the table fills itself.
Aho-Corasick matches many patterns in one pass by adding failure links to a trie. KMP is the single-pattern case.
The event loop runs callbacks to completion; long tasks freeze the page. Microtasks drain before the next render.
Virtual DOM diffing reconciles trees by key. Stable keys turn moves into cheap reorders.
A PID controller sums proportional, integral and derivative terms. Integral windup needs clamping.
Dead reckoning integrates wheel odometry and drifts without landmarks. Sensors close the loop.
A unit test isolates one behavior with a fast, deterministic check. Timeouts catch the infinite loops.
